# privacy-codepoint-tail

行为约定：
maskAccount(text, visible=4) preserves the last visible Unicode code points and replaces each preceding code point with '*'. visible is a nonnegative integer; negative/noninteger values throw RangeError. If visible is 0 mask the entire string; if it exceeds length return text. Count code points rather than UTF-16 code units; do not normalize or group combining marks.

运行：`node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`。
只使用运行时标准库；保持公开接口及原有断言，不安装依赖，不联网。
